entries.zh: 悌；敬爱兄长，敬重尊长（孝悌之悌）
entries.en: to respect one's elders; fraternal respect (Confucian tì, deference to elder brother)

entries.zh: 贵人；受敬重的尊贵之人，有声望者
entries.en: an honored man, a man of respect; a distinguished/precious person

entries.zh: 识时务；认清时势，通晓时机（识时务者为俊杰）
entries.en: to know the signs of the times; to recognize what the moment demands
entries.notes: 西栏[空]，释义据汉字'識時務'判；M首音节'bor'与本页'bat'(識，见position 12)不合，或为原件誊写/辨读差异。

entries.zh: 尊敬；尊崇敬奉，礼敬他人
entries.en: to respect, honor, revere

entries.zh: 敬重；尊重而敬事之
entries.en: to respect and hold in esteem; to honor
entries.notes: M栏[残]且两音节T99污损；释义依西栏respetar与汉字'敬重'判，待复核。

entries.zh: 钦敬；敬仰敬服
entries.en: to admire and revere; respectful esteem

entries.zh: 钦仰；敬仰仰慕
entries.en: to admire and look up to; to venerate

entries.zh: 名分；名位身分，按名分尊卑而敬（长幼之序）
entries.en: one's proper station and status (name and place); respect due by rank
entries.notes: M两音节T99污损；'名分'与'respetar a los mayores'的关联（因名分而敬长）为推断，待复核。

entries.zh: 鞠躬；屈身弯腰行礼（向尊长致敬）
entries.en: to bow, to bend the body in salutation / obeisance

entries.zh: 上覆；书信答覆、传语问候（下对上禀覆）；亦指覆盖于上
entries.en: to reply to a superior / to convey respects (letter formula); to cover over from above
entries.notes: 西栏[空]，据汉字'上覆'与M'siang hog'判，取书札禀覆、传语问候义为主。

entries.zh: 瞻仰；怀着敬意仰望、敬仰
entries.en: to gaze up with reverence; to look up to, venerate
entries.notes: H[疑:瞻/膽]，依M'chiam'判'瞻'，成'瞻仰'；与西栏respetar mucho mirando（凝视而深敬）相合。

entries.zh: 识尊卑；懂得尊卑上下，知礼敬长
entries.en: to know how to respect — knowledge of courtesy and one's due place
entries.notes: 西栏字面作'no saber de cortesia'（不知礼），与汉字'識尊卑'（知尊卑）正反相左，疑西栏断句或否定词误连，释义以汉字与M'bat chun py'为准。

entries.zh: 重望；德高望重、素有声望（敬重贤德望重之人）
entries.en: high repute, esteemed standing; to respect men of virtue and renown
entries.notes: M两音节T99污损；释义据汉字'重望'与西栏respetar a los virtuosos判，待复核。

entries.zh: 敬人即敬己；敬重他人即是敬重自己（末字原件[疑:巳/己]，按'己'读）
entries.en: to respect compadres (godfathers); honoring one's baptismal kin (compadrazgo)
entries.notes: H末字[疑:巳/己]，按音'guy'与文义判'己'；西栏'Respetar de conpadros'（敬神亲/教父）与汉字未全合，en依西栏另记。

entries.zh: 气；气息、呼气（复合词第二字原件不明）
entries.en: breath; to breathe out / gasp (Spanish headword uncertain: respudio/resullio, perhaps resollar 'gasp, pant' or resoplar 'puff')
entries.notes: 西栏西语词本身[疑:respudio/resullio]，或为resollar/resoplar（喘息/喷气）；M作'cui : guy'第二字未明，复合词义无法定夺，仅据'氣'给气息义。

entries.zh: 喘；急喘、喘息（气促如将死之人）
entries.en: to pant, gasp — to breathe hard as one dying

entries.zh: 气喘；喘气急促，呼吸急迫如垂死
entries.en: panting / gasping for breath (as if dying); asthmatic hard breathing
entries.notes: 第二音节T99污损且H[疑:喘/絆]，按M'choan'判'喘'成'氣喘'；栏有缺损故降为low。

entries.zh: 气紧；气息紧促（末字原件[疑:紧/绊]，依音'guin'判'紧'）
entries.en: tight, labored breathing; to breathe hard as the artery (pulse) beats
entries.notes: H末字[疑:緊/絆]依M'guin'判'緊'；西栏'como el arteria'（如脉管搏动般喘息，17世纪医学视动脉为运气之管）义为推断。

entries.zh: 光；发光，闪耀
entries.en: to shine, gleam, give light; radiance
entries.notes: M仅一音节'cui'且T99污损，与'光'惯读不合（或为'輝'类字）；释义依西栏resplandecer与汉字'光'判。

entries.zh: 亮；光亮明亮，闪耀发光
entries.en: to be bright, to shine; brightness, gleam
